title: Branch Prophecy
summary: Branch Prophecy gathers prophetic texts about a righteous branch from David's line.
historical_context: The branch image appears after the collapse of monarchy and promises a renewed Davidic ruler.
ancient_near_east_context: Prophetic literature addresses imperial pressure, covenant breach, temple life, and national collapse within the ancient Near East.
literary_context: Prophetic speech uses poetry, oracle forms, sign actions, and symbolic imagery to confront and comfort the covenant people.
covenantal_significance: Branch Prophecy shows how judgment, mercy, and hope serve the covenant storyline.
interpretive_notes: Read the oracle first in its own historical setting.
Prophetic speech is covenantal proclamation before it is prediction.
common_questions: How does Branch Prophecy fit the biblical storyline?
